# Ordergroove Brand Hub

> The internal home for the Ordergroove brand: guidelines, downloadable assets,
> and resources for employees. Ordergroove is the enterprise
> standard for subscriptions and recurring revenue.

## Canon
- Category: Autonomous Subscriptions (never "Relationship Commerce")
- Typeface: Figtree everywhere
- Core color: Midnight #17132F, Groovy Green #00FF85 (dark bg) / #009A50 (light bg)
- Never lead with "AI". No em-dashes. "Everychannel" is one word. Never name competitors.

## Pages
- [Foundation & Messaging](/foundation): who we are, the category, the message ladder
- [Voice & Language Rules](/voice): how we sound, plus the pass/fail language rules
- [Visual Identity](/visual-identity): color, logo, gradients, signature shapes
- [Icons](/#icons): Material Symbols Rounded, icon colors, and Plain, Tinted, and Solid treatments
- [Icon library](/icon-library): all 293 brand icons as PNG (512 px) or SVG, in every icon color and Plain, Tinted, or Solid, one at a time or as a ZIP
- [Downloads](/#downloads): available logos and backgrounds, including the Zoom background
- [Design canvas](/design-canvas): on-brand LinkedIn graphics with your photo, for new employees and events
- [AI Resources & Guidance](/ai-resources): what you can share with AI tools, Claude skills in the org library, training, Slack channels, and connectors
